contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C ALLECTVS P F AVG

A copper alloy radiate of Allectus, AD 293-296 (Reece Period 14). Obverse inscription: IMP C ALLECTVS P F AVG; probably radiate, draped and cuirassed right. Reverse inscription and type: illegible. Mint unclear. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
